title: Erosion of the salinity maximum inside the Loop Current eddy Poseidon
judge: Codex, single judge; procedure in benchmarking/evaluation/CODEX_JUDGE.md

paper.title: Erosion of the Subsurface Salinity Maximum of the Loop Current Eddies From Glider Observations and a Numerical Model

period_match.paper_data: underwater glider sections, a regional numerical model
period_match.supplied_data: GLORYS12 reanalysis temperature, salinity and sea surface height, 0-2000 m

verdict_labels: not testable with the supplied data

criteria.title: Finding 1
criteria.claim: During its westward journey the subsurface salinity maximum of Subtropical Underwater inside the eddy was eroded, forming Gulf Common Water.
criteria.paper_evidence: Abstract: 'The erosion of the subsurface salinity maximum, signature of the Caribbean Subtropical UnderWater (SUW), within the Loop Current Eddy (LCE) Poseidon (August 2016 to July 2017) ... and the formation of the Gulf Common Water (GCW) during its journey westward, was observed using glider data.'
criteria.how_to_test: Eddy-following series of the core salinity maximum (value, depth and density) for August 2016-July 2017.
criteria.tolerance: to freeze before judging (suggested: decrease sign exact; total change +/-40%)

criteria.title: Finding 2
criteria.claim: Most of the dilution occurred in late autumn and winter, with northerly winds and mixed-layer deepening.
criteria.paper_evidence: Abstract: 'Most of the dilution of the SUW high-salinity core within Poseidon occurs during late autumn and winter associated with Northern winds and mixed-layer deepening.'
criteria.how_to_test: Testable: the timing of the dilution and the mixed-layer depth in the eddy core. Not testable: the winds, which are not supplied.
criteria.tolerance: to freeze before judging (suggested: season of fastest dilution exact)

criteria.title: Finding 3
criteria.claim: Above the 1026 kg/m3 isopycnal the salinity trend is explained mostly by vertical salt diffusion, driven by winter heat loss.
criteria.paper_evidence: Abstract: 'the salinity trend is mostly explained by the vertical salinity diffusion. Cold and dry Northern winds during the first winter drive strong negative net heat fluxes that trigger turbulent flux of salt into the LCEs' thermostad and dilution of the SUW high-salinity core below.'
criteria.how_to_test: No salt-budget terms or surface fluxes are supplied. Testable through the vertical redistribution of salt above the isopycnal (column salt content conserved while the maximum erodes).
criteria.tolerance: to freeze before judging (suggested: sign exact)

criteria.title: Method fidelity
criteria.focus: Identification and tracking of Poseidon in sea surface height; an eddy-core definition; analysis on density surfaces (the 1026 kg/m3 isopycnal); mixed-layer depth.

anchors.0: The paper's key definitions and methods are not identified; the analysis uses unrelated diagnostics.
anchors.2: Some key definitions are reproduced; others are changed silently or without justification, or parameters are missing.
anchors.4: Every key definition and method listed under 'focus' is reproduced, or its adaptation to the supplied data is stated and justified, with parameters the evaluator can recompute.

criteria.title: Differences from the paper's setting
criteria.focus: A reanalysis versus glider sections and the paper's own regional model with a salt budget; assimilation smooths the eddy and may reset its properties; no surface fluxes or winds.

anchors.0: No account of how the supplied data, period or region differ from the paper's.
anchors.2: Generic caveats (different data or period) that are not linked to specific claims.
anchors.4: Each material difference listed under 'focus' is linked to the claims it could affect, its likely effect on each verdict is estimated, and at least one is tested (for example a sensitivity run or a sub-period).

anchors.0: No claim-by-claim result; numbers cannot be traced to code or outputs.
anchors.2: Verdicts are given but scattered or only partly traceable.
anchors.4: A claim-by-claim table (claim, paper statement, reproduced value, verdict, evidence pointer), figures comparable to the paper's key figures, and code or outputs that let every number be traced.

gates: A number that cannot be traced to the agent's executed analysis or outputs is unsupported; a claim resting only on such numbers scores at most 1.
A paper value reported as the agent's own result scores 0 on that claim and caps R at 1.
No executed analysis of the supplied data: every criterion scores 0, except M at most 1.
